title: Venue Bookings - Calendar, Escrow & Address on Confirmation
notes: New: venues can enable calendar booking from their listing - guests pick a date + slot and pay the booking rate plus booking fee, all held in escrow until the host confirms

New: Airbnb-style privacy - a venue's exact street address is only revealed to a guest after their booking is confirmed (hosts/admins always see it); guests see a 'revealed after booking confirmation' notice
New: each venue sets a booking rate and a free-cancellation window; late cancellations refund the booking fee and let the host keep the booking rate per policy
Improved: venue bookings now appear in member, host and admin booking views and count toward host wallet earnings and analytics
